decisions.quote: Results indicated that the accuracy and timeliness of the PM schedules for the current sample was poorer than the accuracy and timeliness reported by Jenkins and colleagues. In line with the results of the original study, however, these results indicated that intermittent PM schedules sufficiently predicted student true growth compared to weekly PM schedule.
decisions.reason: The study re-tested two primary research questions from Jenkins et al. (2017)—relative schedule accuracy and weeks required to reach accuracy thresholds—and explicitly contrasts its poorer accuracy and longer time to reach thresholds (9–12 vs. 4–6 weeks) with the original while confirming the relative comparability of intermittent and weekly schedules. Because one tested finding agrees with the original and another is explicitly contrasted as differing, the outcome is mixed.
